languageHint.title: Language hint
languageHint.description: Optional hint like en, hi, auto

keepLocalVideo.title: Keep local video
keepLocalVideo.description: If true, do not delete the downloaded file after processing

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry the Instagram download before giving up.

computeOutlierScore.title: Compute outlier score
computeOutlierScore.description: If true, fetch a sample of the account's recent reels online to build a views baseline and compute an outlier score (this reel's views / the account's median views). Best-effort: Instagram may rate-limit unauthenticated profile listings, in which case the score is null with a reason.

outlierSampleSize.title: Outlier baseline sample size
outlierSampleSize.description: How many of the account's recent reels to sample when building the outlier baseline. Larger is more stable but slower and more likely to be throttled by Instagram.

instagramCookiesJson.title: Instagram cookies (JSON)
instagramCookiesJson.description: Optional JSON array of Instagram account cookies to unlock view counts and follower counts. Format: [{"name":"sessionid","value":"...","domain":".instagram.com"}]. Without cookies, Instagram hides view_count and channel_follower_count on unauthenticated requests.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy used for the Instagram download. Residential proxy is strongly recommended at scale to avoid being blocked.
